v.s: When the Occurrence occurs,
v.c: When the Inevitable Event takes place,
v.h: The Three Groups on Judgment Day

q: ...there shall be none to deny its occurrence.
v.s: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
v.c: then no one can deny it has come.

q: (those Kuffaar who behaved haughtily in this world)
(those humble and sincere Mu'mineen who were looked down upon in this world).
v.s: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
v.c: It will debase ˹some˺ and elevate ˹others˺.

v.s: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
v.c: When the earth will be violently shaken,

q: And the mountains will be shattered
v.s: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
v.c: and the mountains will be crushed to pieces,

v.s: And become dust dispersing,
v.c: becoming scattered ˹particles of˺ dust,

v.s: And you become [of] three kinds:
v.c: you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups:

q: how excellent are the people of the right!
(They are referred to as the “people of the right” because they will receive the record of their actions in their right hands, indicating their entry into jannah.)
v.s: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
v.c: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be;

q: the people of the left; how wretched are the people of the left!
(They are referred to as the “people of the left” because they will receive the record of their actions in their left hands, indicating their entry into Jahannam.)
v.s: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?
v.c: the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be;

q: (in Jannah). (They are the third group, who comprise of Mu'mineen of the highest calibre, such as the Ambiyaa ﵊ and the Siddiqeen.)
v.s: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
v.c: and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺.

v.s: Those are the ones brought near [to God]
v.c: They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺,

v.s: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
v.c: in the Gardens of Bliss.

q: (Making up this group of the forerunners, there shall be)
A large group from among the earlier ones
v.s: A [large] company of the former peoples
v.c: ˹They will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

q: ...and a few from among the later ones

(the people after Rasulullaah ﷺ). (The people before Rasulullaah ﷺ make up a large portion of this group because they were greater in number and because there were tens of thousands of Ambiyaa ﵊ among them while no Nabi will come after Rasulullaah ﷺ.)
v.s: And a few of the later peoples,
v.c: and a few from later generations.

q: (thrones woven with thread of) pure gold).
v.s: On thrones woven [with ornament],
v.c: ˹All will be˺ on jewelled thrones,

q: Reclining on these facing each other
(so that they can easily converse with each other).
v.s: Reclining on them, facing each other.
v.c: reclining face to face.

v.s: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.
v.c: They will be waited on by eternal youths

q: ...with goblets and jugs and glasses filled with flowing
v.s: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
v.c: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream,

q: Neither will they suffer headaches with it
(because it will be unlike the impure wine of this world).
v.s: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
v.c: that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication.

q: a variety of fruits to choose from...
v.s: And fruit of what they select
v.c: ˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose

q: ...and the meat of the birds they desire.
v.s: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
v.c: and meat from any bird they desire.

q: (in addition to all of this, they shall have)
v.s: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
v.c: And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes,

q: (because of their beauty, complexion and purity).
v.s: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
v.c: like pristine pearls,

q: As a reward for the deeds they carried out
v.s: As reward for what they used to do.
v.c: ˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do.

v.s: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
v.c: There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk —

q: (Peace). (They will greet each other with the words of Salaam; will be greeted by the angels with these words; and Allaah will also greet them with these words.)
v.s: Only a saying: “Peace, peace.”
v.c: only good and virtuous speech.

q: The people of the right, how excellent are the people of the right!,
v.s: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
v.c: And the people of the right—how ˹blessed˺ will they be!

v.s: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.
v.c: ˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees,

v.s: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].
v.c: clusters of bananas,

q: ...(They will be enjoying all these bounties)
(The environment will be without harsh sunshine. Although they; will have ample light, they will feel comfortable like a person who is shaded.)
v.s: And shade extended.
v.c: extended shade,

v.s: And water poured out
v.c: flowing water,

v.s: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
v.c: abundant fruit—

q: ...that will not come to an end
(because another fruit will immediately grow in the place of a plucked one)
(they will have as much as they please)...
v.s: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
v.c: never out of season nor forbidden—

v.s: And [upon] beds raised high.
v.c: and elevated furnishings.

q: Indeed We have created these damsels
(whom the “people of the right” shall marry)
(without any impurities in their bodies or their behaviour).
v.s: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
v.c: Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates,

q: And We have made them all
v.s: And made them virgins,
v.c: making them virgins,

q: (every facet of their appearance and behaviour will be pleasing to their husbands)
v.s: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
v.c: loving and of equal age,

v.s: For the companions of the right [who are]
v.c: for the people of the right,

q: (Making up the people of the right shall be)
v.s: A company of the former peoples
v.c: ˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

v.s: And a company of the later peoples.
v.c: and a multitude from later generations.

q: the people of the left, how wretched are the people of the left!
v.s: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
v.c: And the people of the left—how ˹miserable˺ will they be!

v.s: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
v.c: ˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water,

v.s: And a shade of black smoke,
v.c: in the shade of black smoke,

q: ...that will neither be cool nor hospitable.
(Rather, it will add to the heat and misery.)
v.s: Neither cool nor beneficial.
v.c: neither cool nor refreshing.

q: Verily these people used to indulgence in their wealth and luxuries before
v.s: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
v.c: Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury,

q: They used to persistently commit major sins
(like Shirk, belying the Ambiyaa ﵊ and denying resurrection).
v.s: And they used to persist in the great violation,
v.c: and persisted in the worst of sin.

q: They used to say, “After we die and have become sand and bones, will we then be resurrected
v.s: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
v.c: They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?

v.s: And our forefathers [as well]?"
v.c: And our forefathers as well?”

q: Say, “Indeed the early ones and the latter ones...”
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “Indeed, the former and the later peoples
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations

q: “...shall certainly be gathered for an appointment of a known day
v.s: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
v.c: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day.

v.s: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
v.c: Then you, O misguided deniers,

q: “...you shall surely eat from the Zaqqoom
v.s: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
v.c: will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm,

q: “And you shall fill your bellies with it
v.s: And filling with it your bellies
v.c: filling up ˹your˺ bellies with it.

q: (to try to force the scraps down)...”
v.s: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.
v.c: Then on top of that you will drink boiling water—

q: “...and you shall drink like thirsty camels.”
v.s: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
v.c: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”

q: This is the hospitality they will receive on the Day of Reckoning.
v.s: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
v.c: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment.

q: We have created you, so why do you
v.s: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
v.c: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺?

q: (Do you have control over its course and the process of conception?)
v.s: Have you seen that which you emit?
v.c: Have you considered what you ejaculate?

q: Do you create the child or are We the Creators?
v.s: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
v.c: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so?

q: We have decreed death among you and We are not helpless...
v.s: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
v.c: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented

q: to replace you with others like you and make you into forms
that you have no knowledge of.
v.s: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
v.c: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you.

q: You already have knowledge of the first
creation, so why do you not take heed
(and realise that it is simple for Allaah to create you again on the Day of Qiyaamah)?
v.s: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
v.c: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful?

q: Tell me about what you plant.
v.s: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
v.c: Have you considered what you sow?

q: grow or are We the Ones who make it grow?
v.s: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
v.c: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so?

q: If We wish We could reduce it
v.s: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
v.c: If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament,

v.s: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
v.c: “We have truly suffered a ˹great˺ loss.

v.s: Rather, we have been deprived."
v.c: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

q: Tell me about the water you drink.
v.s: And have you seen the water that you drink?
v.c: Have you considered the water you drink?

q: Do you cause it to rain from the clouds or is it We Who cause it to rain?
v.s: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
v.c: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who do so?

m: then why are you not grateful
then why are you not grateful
q: If We willed it, We could have made the water salty
(depriving you of anything to quench your thirst),
so why are you not grateful?
v.s: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
v.c: If We willed, We could make it salty. Will you not then give thanks?

q: Tell me about the fire that you kindle.
v.s: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
v.c: Have you considered the fire you kindle?

q: or is it We Who created it?
v.s: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
v.c: Is it you who produce its trees, or is it We Who do so?

m: for the wayfarers in the desert
q: We have made it as a reminder
and as a source of benefit to the travellers
(who are then able to light fires as they journey).
v.s: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
v.c: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers.

q: So glorify the name of your Majestic Rabb
(to express your thanks for everything He has given you).
v.s: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
v.c: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.

q: I swear by the positions of the stars
v.s: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
v.c: So I do swear by the positions of the stars—

q: This is undoubtedly a great oath if you
v.s: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
v.c: and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath—

v.s: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.
v.c: that this is truly a noble Quran,

v.s: In a Register well-protected;.
v.c: in a well-preserved Record,

q: (the angels, who are pure from sin)
(the “Lowhul Mahfoodh”). (The Shayaateen and all evil forces have absolutely no access to it.)
v.s: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
v.c: touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺.

q: A revelation from the Rabb of the universe.
v.s: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
v.c: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.

v.s: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
v.c: How can you then take this message lightly,

q: Have you fixed as your shares
v.s: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
v.c: and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial?

q: (if you feel powerful enough to oppose the message of your Creator)
when the soul reaches the throat
v.s: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
v.c: Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat,
v.h: A Challenge to Deniers of the Hereafter

v.s: And you are at that time looking on -
v.c: while you are looking on?

q: We are even nearer to him than you but you fail to see
(despite knowing at that moment that We are in control of all affairs, you still choose to exert your opinions over Ours and reject what We say).
v.s: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
v.c: And We are nearer to such a person than you, but you cannot see.

q: If you are exempt from being resurrected
v.s: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
v.c: Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺,

q: (of a dead person to his body)
(in your claim that things will happen as you wish and not as the Ambiyaa ﵊ inform you)?
v.s: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
v.c: bring that soul back, if what you say is true.

q: if someone it from among those brought close
v.s: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to God],
v.c: So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺,
v.h: Which of the Three Will You Be?

v.s: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
v.c: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss.

q: If he was from among the people of the right...
v.s: And if he was of the companions of the right,
v.c: And if the deceased is one of the people of the right,

q: “Peace be on you. You are from the people of the right
v.s: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
v.c: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”

q: However, if he was among the rejecters
v.s: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
v.c: But if such person is one of the misguided deniers,

v.s: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
v.c: then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺

v.s: And burning in Hellfire.
v.c: and burning in Hellfire.

q: This is most definitely the irrefutable
v.s: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
v.c: Indeed, this is the absolute truth.

q: So glorify the name of your Majestic Rabb
(and do your best to secure salvation in the Aakhirah).
v.s: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
v.c: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.
